title: Greek-Style Pan-Seared Steak with Saganaki
description: A classic combination of tender steak and crispy saganaki, served with a side of tangy feta salad.
instructions: Season the steak with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, red wine vinegar, and oregano to make a marinade.
Brush the marinade on both sides of the steak and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add the steak.
Sear the steak for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for an additional 8-10 minutes.
Remove the steak from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, crumble the saganaki cheese and sprinkle it over the steak.
Return the skillet to the stovetop over medium heat and add a tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the crumbled saganaki cheese to the skillet and cook until it's crispy and golden brown.
Serve the steak with the crispy saganaki cheese on top.
